messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: stream-gen-prod p99 latency breach in eu-central-1: 2.7s (SLO 1.0s). Streaming stall rate increased. Paging: eng-oncall.
sam_oncall: i'm on it. seeing the page. is this across all zones?
priya_sre: looks concentrated to eu-central-1b. p95 is ~380ms, p99 ~2.7s. spike started ~09:03 UTC.
dan_infra: pulling node-level metrics. one GPU node showing repeated PCIe resets and correctable ECC spikes: node gpu-42.rack-12. temp sensors showing 91C and climbing.
sam_oncall: if thermal/ECC on a single accelerator it can cause KV cache miss storms and streaming stalls. priya can you confirm replica tail latencies?
priya_sre: per-replica p99: rset-stream-09 -> nodes [gpu-40:0.9s, gpu-41:1.1s, gpu-42:4.2s, gpu-43:0.95s]. routing still round-robin.
luis_ml: no model rollouts in last 24h. traffic mix stable. small uptick on long-form chat pipelines but within normal.
sam_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) remove gpu-42 from routing, 2) drain workloads off that node, 3) temporarily increase replica weight for spare pool, 4) post status. assign roles.
dan_infra: starting cordon+drain:```kubectl cordon node/gpu-42.rack-12
kubectl drain node/gpu-42.rack-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=3m
```
priya_sre: updated routing to prefer rset-stream-09-spares and set node/gpu-42 weight=0. clients will reconnect but should resume.
luis_ml: starting a quick smoke run of streaming model path to validate tails after routing change.
support_team: preparing customer note: "We are investigating elevated streaming latency in eu-central-1b. Mitigation in progress; some clients may observe reconnects or truncated streams." approval?
sam_oncall: yes, go ahead. add ETA 20-30m for mitigation.
hw_bot: Hardware alert: gpu-42.rack-12 reported ECC_Corrected count 310 -> 980 in 12 minutes, PCIe resets 5, fan_rpm lower than nominal. Serial: G42-12R.
dan_infra: drain completed at 09:12 UTC. node shows `temp: 91C -> 87C after idle`, nvml logs attached to ticket. moving node to maintenance.
priya_sre: after drain p99 in eu-central-1 dropped to 0.88s, streaming stall rate back down ~90% from peak. p95 unchanged.
luis_ml: smoke tests green, no model-level anomalies. slight increase in ephemeral reconnect errors immediately after failover.
support_team: posted status update and emailed impacted customers with follow-up.
sam_oncall: good. open HW ticket and capture nvml dumps and node logs. dan can you file and tag datacenter ops?
dan_infra: HW ticket OPEN-5921 created, assigning to dc-ops, including nvml dump, ECC histogram, and thermal logs. also flagged for possible cooler replacement.
priya_sre: short-term improvement looks stable. action items: - auto-failover policy tweak: if replica p99 >1.6s for 3m, set weight 0 and trigger drain. - improve alerting to correlate ECC/thermal with stream-stalls.
sam_oncall: i'll own postmortem. severity P1. priya, dan, luis, support, please add timeline and logs to the doc. i'll hand monitoring to dan for next 6 hours.
luis_ml: note for postmortem: capture request traces for pipeline id 0x9fa3 and KV cache hit/miss around 09:02-09:14 UTC. might help correlate eviction cascade.
support_team: sending 15m update now with mitigation summary and ETA.
hw_bot: suggestion: schedule hardware swap if corrected ECC continues to rise after cooldown.
dan_infra: ack. removing gpu-42 from rotation permanently until hw sign-off. bootstrapping replacement GPU from spare pool.
sam_oncall: thanks all. closing active page, moving to monitored mode. will publish incident summary and RCA doc in incidents repo within 48h. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by sam_oncall. Handoff recorded to dan_infra for maintenance window.
